prompt: SCENE: A sunlit apartment bedroom in the morning, white linen duvet, a pale oak bedside table with a glass of water and a small plant, soft daylight from a window on the left, calm and uncluttered. SUBJECT: A South Asian woman in her early 30s with long dark hair in a loose low bun, wearing a sage-green knit cardigan over a high-neck cream top and soft charcoal joggers, sitting on the edge of the bed, holding a folded sheet of thin white medical foam in both hands and looking at it with a calm, practical expression. Beside her on the duvet lie a curved white ab board and a neatly folded beige compression garment. KEY DETAILS: Editorial lifestyle photograph, 35mm lens, natural light, gentle shadows, natural skin texture, warm neutral palette of cream, stone and sage with a muted gold accent (a thin gold bracelet). Her face, hands and the foam sit in the upper two thirds of the frame; the lower third is the quiet bedspread so a title can sit over it. CONSTRAINTS: 3:2 landscape. Fully clothed, no bare midriff, no garment being worn on skin, no cleavage, no glamour posing. No text, brand names or logos on the foam, board or garment; no phone numbers. No medical instruments, incisions or bruising. Photorealistic, not glossy or stock-like.

SCENE: A clean editorial diagram on a warm off-white (stone-50) background with a thin muted-gold rule at the top. SUBJECT: A stylised, abstract cross-section of four stacked horizontal layers seen slightly from the side, like a cutaway: a smooth warm skin-tone base layer, a soft white foam layer with a fine open-cell texture, a thin curved pale-grey rigid board, and a beige knit compression-fabric top layer. Each layer has a thin leader line to its label on the right. Below the diagram, a two-line note and a small source footer. KEY DETAILS: Flat vector illustration with subtle depth, no human body or silhouette, serif headline in dark stone (stone-900), sans-serif labels, muted gold (gold-500) only for leader lines and the rule, large legible type for phones. Text exactly as given in text_in_image, with no other words. CONSTRAINTS: 4:5 portrait. No people, no anatomy, no practice name, no logo, no phone number, no website address. Spell every word exactly as supplied; no extra numbers.

TEXT IN THE IMAGE. Render exactly these words, line by line, spelled exactly as written, and no other words, numbers or labels:
How lipo foam and boards are layered

Skin (clean and dry)
Lipo foam
Ab board or back board (if your surgeon uses one)
Compression garment

Garment: 4 to 6 weeks over the treated areas (The Aesthetic Society)
Foam and boards: as your surgeon directs

Source: The Aesthetic Society
